decision: Compile the global NO COMPRESSION / NO LOSS policy into the existing Project Control Plane without creating a parallel governance system.
required_machine_behavior: Architecture-layer Control Cards must include an explicit preservation_review.
The review must separate concept_state, presentation_state and truth_evidence_state for established objects.
DEMOTE/CUT decisions require a substantive explicit reason.
Compression, page count, cleaner presentation, shorter film/web or minimalism cannot be the sole removal reason.
The machine contract must not encode C04's 12-layer architecture or any fixed universal chapter count.
does_not_prove: This change does not decide which project objects should be MAIN.
This change does not create Design PASS, Field PASS, Rights PASS, Engineering PASS, Promotion or Release.
This change does not freeze project-specific architectures against later explicit evidence-based restructuring.
